description: This file contains utility functions for normalizing, validating, and matching inbound file path patterns, primarily used for path security or filtering within a project.

methods.name: normalizePosixAbsolutePath
methods.description: Normalizes a POSIX absolute path, returning undefined if invalid.

methods.name: splitPathSegments
methods.description: Splits a path string into segments, filtering out empty segments.

methods.name: matchesRootPattern
methods.description: Checks if a candidate path matches a root pattern, supporting wildcards.

methods.name: isValidInboundPathRootPattern
methods.description: Validates if a path pattern is a valid inbound root pattern.

methods.name: normalizeInboundPathRoots
methods.description: Normalizes and filters a list of inbound path root patterns.

methods.name: mergeInboundPathRoots
methods.description: Merges multiple lists of inbound path roots into a unique set.

methods.name: isInboundPathAllowed
methods.description: Determines if a file path is allowed based on inbound root patterns.
